pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   D. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   C. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   B. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   C. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   D. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Arabic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain My extended family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Surah Naas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
